name: bare_clear
query: SELECT flag, account, count(*) AS n, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last, sum(position) AS total FROM CLEAR WHERE account ~ '^Equity' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
notes: CLEAR without CLOSE: the transfer entries are dated like the last entry of the ledger (here a price on 2017-09-08).
